thread:
Maya (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize scope for the "visibility" ship: dashboards, tracing hooks, cost breakdown, and error analytics. customer asks piling up. propose a lean M1.
Jon (Eng): +1. What's the M1 exact checklist? we should avoid doing full APM in v1.
Maya (PM): M1 (must): per-route token & cost breakdown, 95/50 latency heatmap, top-10 error traces with stack snippets, basic distributed trace hook (sampled). Nice-to-have: inferred root-cause tags and session replay later.
Aline (SRE): For the error traces, we need fingerprinting and a playbook mapping errors -> runbook links. Also retention: keep full traces for 7 days, aggregates for 90.
Kevin (Data): DB / metrics load question: storing full traces at high QPS will spike cost. propose sampling at 1% by default + adaptive bump on error spikes, and pre-aggregations for per-route cost metrics.
Ruth (Design): I can mock the dashboard layout but need the acceptance criteria: what are the primary user tasks? (e.g., find route cost, drill into error trace, open trace to see prompt+response).
Jon (Eng): Tasks for eng (initial):
- tracing header + sampling: example header `x-redwood-trace-sample: 1`
- instrument route-level counters: tokens_in, tokens_out, model_ms, inference_ms
- ingestion pipeline to metrics DB + short-term trace store
- UI API for per-route time-series + drilldowns
(backend effort estimate: 3 sprints for a small team)
Maya (PM): Launch criteria (MUST):
- per-route cost/time dashboard visible for top 50 routes
- error alerting integrated with PagerDuty (error rate > baseline * 3 for 5m)
- ability to view one full sampled trace (prompt+response tokens) in UI
- docs + runbook links for SREs
If any of these fail, we call it gated.
Aline (SRE): Also MUST: ability to disable trace ingestion per-customer in runtime, and quota enforcement to avoid runaway Kinesis/ingest costs. Rollback path should be a feature flag to turn off tracing.
Kevin (Data): For cost math, I'll own the model: per-token compute cost mapping to route-level cost, plus infra amortization. Need schema from eng for `tokens_in/out` and model name mapping.
Jon (Eng): Quick config snippet for sampling logic we discussed:
```
# sampling config (pseudo)
routes:
  /v1/chat:
    sample: 0.01
    on_error_sample: 0.1
```
Also we'll emit `trace_id` and `route_id` headers and store trace metadata in short-term store.
Ruth (Design): Layout notes: primary nav: Overview (cost + latency), Routes (list + filter), Errors (top traces), Traces (raw). Will send mock images by EOD. keep charts compact, large table for top routes.
Maya (PM): Customer asks prioritized: (1) per-route billing visibility (2) error analytics for enterprise customers (3) traces for debugging. We should map (1) to M1, (2) partial M1 (top errors), (3) sampled traces M1.
Aline (SRE): Operational readiness checklist: runbooks linked, alert thresholds documented, guardrails for sampling, retention SLA, and a canary to test ingest at 100 RPS for a single test org.
Jon (Eng): Questions: do we need correlation with existing request IDs? if yes, we should recommend clients send `x-request-id`. we can fall back to generated IDs but correlation will be weaker.
Maya (PM): Ask sales/CS to push `x-request-id` in customer integrations. I'll drop a note in the CS tracker. also tag enterprise customers for higher sampling by default.
Kevin (Data): On infra side: I'll prototype pre-agg query for daily per-route cost and the 95/50 latency percentiles. need eng telemetry events schema by Monday.
Ruth (Design): Ack — I'll build mocks around the metrics we listed. small ask: include a quick-export CSV button for routes table.
Jon (Eng): Timeline proposal: sprint 1: instrumentation + ingestion pipeline; sprint 2: metrics aggregation + basic UI; sprint 3: alerts + runbooks + polish. Owners: Jon (backend), Kevin (metrics), Ruth (UI), Aline (ops), Maya (PM).
deploy-bot: CI smoke: visibility-instrumentation branch passed unit tests and linting :white_check_mark:
Maya (PM): Next steps: 1) Jon to PR sampling header & counters by Mon; 2) Kevin to wire pre-agg demo by Wed; 3) Ruth to share mocks EOD; 4) Aline to draft runbook template. I'll sync with CS on request-id ask.
Jon (Eng): I'll open the PR today and tag reviewers. @Aline we'll add the feature-flag for tracing ingestion in the same diff.
Aline (SRE): Good plan. Will prepare the canary checklist and PD integration doc.
Maya (PM): Thanks all — let's aim to show a working demo to the GTM folks in 3 weeks. :rocket:
Jon (Eng): :thumbsup:
Ruth (Design): :thumbsup:
Kevin (Data): noted
Aline (SRE): 👍
Maya (PM): closing the thread, will follow up with calendar invite for weekly visibility sync.
